inflight_experience_food_beverage: Anything about food or drinks during the flight (quality, taste, temperature, freshness, quantity, variety, special meals, drink service).
inflight_experience_seats_comfort: Seat comfort on board (legroom, recline, seat width, cushioning, ability to sleep/rest, personal space, seat layout).
inflight_experience_entertainment: In-flight entertainment and connectivity (screens, movies/TV/music, games, Wi-Fi/internet, system usability, system not working).
inflight_experience_cabin_service: Cabin crew and service during the flight (friendliness, politeness, professionalism, responsiveness, language skills, service speed/attentiveness).
inflight_experience_cleanliness: Cleanliness inside the aircraft (seats, tray tables, toilets, floors, smell, general hygiene, trash not collected, dirty cabin).
checkin_process: Check-in experience at the airport or online (desks, kiosks, queues, waiting time, staff at check-in, technical issues with check-in).
boarding_process: Boarding at the gate (announcements, boarding order, priority boarding, crowd management, waiting at the gate, confusion during boarding).
baggage_lost: Lost or missing baggage (bags not arriving, bags delayed to another flight, bags sent to the wrong airport or never found).
baggage_damaged: Damaged baggage (broken wheels, torn bags, damaged contents, visible damage after arrival).
booking_and_ticketing: Booking and ticket management (website/app issues, payment problems, ticket changes, rebooking, schedule changes, errors during purchase, confirmation issues).
customer_support: Any interaction with customer support (call center, email, chat, social media), including response time, politeness, clarity, helpfulness, and resolution quality.
pricing_and_loyalty: Ticket prices, extra fees, value for money, and loyalty/miles (fare levels, hidden charges, surcharges, fairness of price, miles/points, status, benefits).
